figuresAndAnatomy.title: HuBMAP Human Reference Atlas
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Visible Human male. Skin, heart, great vessels and liver. The intro's silver studio render adapts the native anatomy with decorative lighting and camera motion; anatomical registration is retained.

figuresAndAnatomy.title: BodyParts3D
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Ribs, clavicles, scapulae, sternum, manubrium, xiphoid and thoracic spine, registered into HRA space. The skin relief adapts the registered anterior bone surfaces as softened shading landmarks. These registered resources also belong to the native scene used for the intro's studio adaptation.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: Database Center for Life Science

figuresAndAnatomy.title: Decoding VExUS · Figure 4
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Subcostal IVC–hepatic-vein–RA still cropped for the RAP and pericardial acquisition insets; the app adds the PW cursor and sample gate without altering the clinical anatomy.

figuresAndAnatomy.title: MR PISA clinical inset · Figure 2
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Clinical colour-Doppler panel cropped for the MR PISA recognition inset. No clinical pixels were recoloured or retouched; the app-authored diagram and measurements remain separate.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: Andreas Hagendorff, Fabian Knebel, Andreas Helfen et al.

figuresAndAnatomy.title: TR PISA clinical inset · Figure 1A
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Clinical tricuspid-regurgitation colour-Doppler panel shown as recognition context. The source figure is bundled unretouched; the app-authored PISA diagram and live measurements remain separate.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: Beiqi Chen, Yu Liu, Wuxu Zuo et al.

figuresAndAnatomy.title: MS PISA anatomy and CW references · Figure 4A–B
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Clinical A4C anatomy and mitral CW panel crops. Source pixels remain unchanged. The anatomy inset is a location reference, not a clinical PISA-radius measurement; native animations teach the calipers separately.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: Juan Manuel Monteagudo Ruiz & José Luis Zamorano Gómez

figuresAndAnatomy.title: Pulmonic-valve PSAX anatomy · Figure 1A
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Parasternal short-axis panel focused on the pulmonic valve and pulmonary artery. Cropped with an app-added PV locator; clinical pixels are preserved. The original unannotated PSAX panel opens from the inset.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: Pietro Costantini, Francesco Perone, Agnese Siani et al.

figuresAndAnatomy.title: Pulmonic-stenosis CW inset · E00693
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Systolic-spectrum crop from a transpulmonary CW recording. Source pixels and measurements are preserved; the full original opens from the tracing inset. Source and crop adaptations are CC BY-SA 3.0. Source example values never populate calculator inputs.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: AMC Echolab, AMC, The Netherlands · CardioNetworks / ECHOpedia

figuresAndAnatomy.title: Aortic-stenosis LVOT diameter · Figure 2
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Clinical PLAX LVOT-diameter crop shown beside the app-authored acquisition plate. It also appears in the intro's recorded native PLAX lesson demonstration and poster. The source patient value never becomes the calculator entry.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: Giovanni Santangelo, Maurizio Bursi, Francesco Faggiano et al.

figuresAndAnatomy.title: Aortic-stenosis Doppler acquisition · Figures 9–10
figuresAndAnatomy.detail: Separate apical five-chamber crops preserve the source PW sample volume proximal to the aortic valve and the source CW cursor through the valve. They provide acquisition recognition beside app-authored spectra; both crops are disclosed as modifications. The intro and pericardial LVOT acquisition reference reuse the Figure 10 PW crop unchanged.
figuresAndAnatomy.creator: Angelica Poniros, Kerry Nevin, Gilbert H. L. Tang & Lucy M. Safi

videos.title: PLAX normal

videos.creator: Atif Qasim, MD MSCE · Echocardiographer.org
videos.modifications: Original MP4 supplied by Mohammed on 2026-09-20 and assigned to the papillary-muscle view at his request; no transcoding, crop or image changes. Optional anatomy labels are drawn by the app. Playback omits the container’s trailing still hold without retiming the recorded frames. No audio track. The app makes the scanner surround black outside a protected sector boundary; a fixed smooth contrast curve gently lowers the sector’s grey veil while retaining tonal order and black/white endpoints. No sharpening, rescaling or motion synthesis is applied. The app also covers the nonclinical JPEG format stamp outside the acquired fan, preserving acquisition settings, heart rate and ECG. The bundled MP4 is unchanged by these display treatments.

videos.creator: Atif Qasim, MD MSCE · Echocardiographer.org
videos.modifications: Original 528 × 360 MP4 supplied by Mohammed on 2026-09-20. At his request, contrast and black level were adjusted, then the image was enlarged 3× with Lanczos scaling and gentle luminance sharpening to 1584 × 1080. H.264 presentation derivative; no crop, anatomy synthesis or retiming. Upscaling adds no acquired detail. The silent audio track was omitted; optional anatomy labels are drawn by the app. The app makes the scanner surround black outside a protected sector boundary; no additional filtering, scaling or contrast adjustment is applied inside the sector. The bundled MP4 is unchanged by this display treatment.
